import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import mir_eval
import numpy as np

n = len(ref_intervals)
# Reuse ref_freqs, ensuring it matches the length of ref_intervals
pitches = np.resize(ref_freqs, n) if len(ref_freqs) > 0 else np.full(n, 440.0)
# Ensure strictly positive frequencies to avoid log2(0) warnings in hz_to_midi conversion
pitches = np.where(pitches <= 0, 440.0, pitches)

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax_ret = mir_eval.display.piano_roll(
    ref_intervals, 
    pitches=pitches, 
    ax=ax, 
    label="Reference", 
    alpha=0.5, 
    facecolor="r"
)

# piano_roll delegates to labeled_intervals, which adds a Rectangle patch per interval
num_patches = len(ax_ret.patches)
assert ax_ret is ax, "Expected piano_roll to return the provided axes"
assert num_patches == n, f"Expected {n} patches for {n} intervals, got {num_patches}"

print(f"__CHECK__ piano_roll {num_patches}")
